calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-11-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Petitioners Jian Lan Huang and Zhuo Shen Huang; father and mother of minor.
Petitioner Zhuo shen Huang sworn and examined through Cantonese Interpreter Baouy Huang.
Proof of Publication on file.
Declaration from other parent on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Jia Hao Huang to Hugo Huang.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
